description: This file initializes a Flask web application for a notes backend API. It configures CORS, OpenAPI/Swagger UI, database connection, and registers API blueprints for health checks and notes management.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: The API object from flask_smorest used to register blueprints and manage API configurations.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists.

methods.name: CORS
methods.description: Configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing for the Flask app.

methods.name: db.init_app
methods.description: Initializes the database with the Flask application context.

methods.name: db.create_all
methods.description: Creates all database tables based on models.

methods.name: app.app_context
methods.description: Creates an application context for initializing database tables.

methods.name: api.register_blueprint
methods.description: Registers route blueprints with the Flask API.

ctags.name: health_blp
ctags.pattern: /^from .routes.health import blp as health_blp  # noqa: E402$/

ctags.name: notes_blp
ctags.pattern: /^from .routes.notes import blp as notes_blp  # noqa: E402$/
